ev.q: From 1999 to 2017, age-adjusted death rates for Parkinson disease among adults aged ≥65 years increased from 41.7 to 65.3 per 100,000 population.
Deaths per 100,000 population, age-adjusted to 2000 U.S. standard population.
Among men, the age-adjusted death rate increased from 65.2 per 100,000 in 1999 to 97.9 in 2017.
Throughout 1999–2017, the death rates for Parkinson disease for men were higher than those for women.

Source: National Center for Health Statistics, National Vital Statistics System, Mortality Data 1999–2017.
